wraith_king_vampiric_aura.name: Vampiric Spirit
wraith_king_vampiric_aura.description: Grants Wraith King Lifesteal. When slain Wraith King turns into a free pathing Wraith with Bonus Attack and Movement Speed for a short duration, delaying his death. Wraith King cannot reincarnate after being a Wraith.
wraith_king_vampiric_aura.note0: Credit for allies whose death was delayed will go to whoever struck the original killing blow.
wraith_king_vampiric_aura.note2: Break only disables the passive lifesteal component.
wraith_king_vampiric_aura.note3: Respawn timer is reduced by Wraith duration.

wraith_king_hellfire_blast.name: Wraithfire Blast
wraith_king_hellfire_blast.description: Wraith King sears an enemy unit with spectral fire, dealing damage and stunning, then dealing damage over time and slowing the target.
wraith_king_hellfire_blast.lore: Ostarion calls on his damned lineage, laying waste to his opponents.
wraith_king_hellfire_blast.note0: If Wraith King has summoned skeletons, casting Wraithfire Blast on a target will order all of the skeletons to attack that target.

wraith_king_vampiric_aura.name: Vampiric Spirit
wraith_king_vampiric_aura.description: Grants Wraith King Lifesteal. When slain Wraith King turns into a free pathing Wraith with Bonus Attack and Movement Speed for a short duration, delaying his death. Wraith King cannot reincarnate after being a Wraith.
wraith_king_vampiric_aura.note0: Credit for allies whose death was delayed will go to whoever struck the original killing blow.
wraith_king_vampiric_aura.note2: Break only disables the passive lifesteal component.
wraith_king_vampiric_aura.note3: Respawn timer is reduced by Wraith duration.

wraith_king_mortal_strike.name: Mortal Strike
wraith_king_mortal_strike.description: Wraith King passively deals bonus damage on an attack with a cooldown.
wraith_king_mortal_strike.lore: One blow to crush a foe.

wraith_king_reincarnation.name: Reincarnation
wraith_king_reincarnation.description: Wraith King's form regroups after death, allowing him to resurrect when killed in battle.  Upon death, enemy units in a %slow_radius% radius are slowed. Skeletons spawn and attack each nearby enemy hero. Can be self-cast to kill Wraith King instantly.
wraith_king_reincarnation.lore: Conspirators against the Wraith King wonder why he never stays dead.
wraith_king_reincarnation.note0: Wraith King won't revive if he doesn't have enough mana.
wraith_king_reincarnation.note1: Revives with full HP and Mana.
wraith_king_reincarnation.blink_description: Can be used to move to the target point and instantly refresh the cooldown of Wraithfire Blast.
